name: @openemployee/connector-openclaw
description: Govern an OpenClaw agent with MakerChecker: deny-by-default skill grants, segregation of duties, approval gates, and a hash-chained signed audit trail — wired through OpenClaw's plugin policy hooks.

openclaw.comment: Loaded as an OpenClaw plugin; the host provides @openclaw/plugin-sdk at runtime. Not an npm dependency: the connector typechecks against a source-cited shim (src/openclaw-shim.ts) and imports the real definePluginEntry only in src/plugin.ts, which OpenClaw resolves when it loads this directory.
